json.title: [Question][restore] recovery from checkpoint failed

json.body:
It seems that it is not possible to specify the execution.savepoint.path parameter to run
```bash
./bin/chunjun-standalone.sh -job /Users/kino/works/opensource/chunjun/conf/mysql_mysql_batch_transform.json -confProp "{\"state.checkpoints.dir\":\"file:///Users/kino/app/flink/flink-1.12.7/ck\",\"flink.checkpoint.interval\":\"30000\",\"state.backend\":\"filesystem\",\"state.backend.incremental\":\"true\",\"execution.savepoint.path\":\"file:///Users/kino/app/flink/flink-1.12.7/sp/savepoint-44fa76-88842a51f017\"}"
```
